entity_type_mapping.source_shape: Source file, AST-parsed locally after fetch (Tree-sitter, deterministic per §9's code-vs-LLM table -- NOT an LLM extraction step)

temporal_strategy.t_recorded_source: PR merge time as primary anchor for traceability-relevant facts; commit author-date as secondary/best-effort (§5.2's existing Git/Core row -- this manifest is the concrete implementation of what was previously described only abstractly)
temporal_strategy.known_pitfalls: Rebased/squashed history loses individual commit dates -- prefer PR merge events, per §5.2's already-documented mitigation.

notes: REQ-METIS-CONN-03 (new): fetch access only -- the github-mcp-server's --read-only flag (or equivalent for the reference Git server) is mandatory for this connector, mirroring BS-002's architectural separation (extraction has no write credential) at the transport level, not just the pipeline-process level. REVISION (v2.0.0): superseded the original MCP-client design (v1.0.0) per the single-database/no-duplicate-ingestion decision -- this connector now reads from athena-client-git's already-populated Athena tables instead of re-fetching from GitHub directly. The code-graph (CALLS/IMPORTS/INHERITS) extraction still requires a local AST pass, run against file contents Athena already has cached/fetched, not a second live GitHub connection.

athena_internal_read_config.athena_schema_object: athena.mv_commits (and related git-derived objects, resolved via athena_schema_catalog.py)
